text: Prior experimental work reports that messages emphasizing immigrants' economic contributions raise support for immigration (Example & Sample, 2019). Persuasion effects in survey experiments are often moderated by partisanship, with larger effects among co-partisans of the message's implied position (Placeholder, 2021). A fabricated claim [citation removed: not in retrieved set] should be removed.

works.title: Framing immigration: economic contribution messages and public attitudes
works.abstract: Economic framing raises support for immigration.

works.title: Partisan moderation of persuasion effects in survey experiments
